title: Brazilian Naval Revolts
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Brazilian Naval Revolts", at revision 1375631543, opens: "The Brazilian Naval Revolts were armed mutinies promoted mainly by admirals Custódio José de Melo and Saldanha da Gama and their fleet of rebel Brazilian navy ships against the claimed unconstitutional staying in power of president Floriano Peixoto." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2500742, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "series of mutinies in the Brazilian Navy". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
